name: Surabaya (East Java): Indonesian Navy 2nd Fleet and submarine base
note: Home port of the Type 209 boats KRI Nagapasa, KRI Ardadedali and KRI Alugoro; the 2nd Fleet Command is based here (Wikipedia). Position approximate.

name: PT PAL Indonesia shipyard (Surabaya): builds two Scorpene Evolved submarines
note: State shipbuilder. First steel was cut on 7 Aug 2026 for the lead Scorpene Evolved boat; the Navy expects delivery in 2032-33 (Antara; Navy Leaders). Naval Group provides design support. Position approximate.

name: Halim Perdanakusuma Air Force Base (Jakarta): National Air Operations Command
note: National Air Operations Command (Koopsudnas) is headquartered here. The base hosts transport and VIP squadrons; the civil airport shares the runway (Global Military, Aug 2026; Wikipedia).
source: Global Military (Aug 2026); Wikipedia (Halim Perdanakusuma International Airport)

name: Iswahjudi Air Force Base (Maospati, East Java): fighter base, 32nd Air Wing
note: Home to the 32nd Air Wing and four other units (ICAO WARI; Global Military, Aug 2026).

name: Sultan Hasanuddin Air Force Base (Makassar): 33rd Air Wing, Su-27/Su-30
note: Su-30MK2 overran the runway on 24 Aug 2026 during a simulated take-off after a major overhaul; the crew was unhurt (migflug, 2026). Position approximate.

name: Manuhua Air Force Base (Biak, Papua): 13th Air Wing; 27th Air Squadron (CN235)
note: ICAO WABB; runway 11/29, 3,571 m (migflug, 2026; Wikipedia). Position approximate.

name: Raden Sadjad Air Force Base (Ranai, Natuna Islands)
note: ICAO WIDO; runway 18/36, 2,560 m (Wikipedia, Indonesian Air Force listing). The Natuna Islands face the South China Sea. Position approximate.

name: Sunda Strait (Java-Sumatra)
note: Strait between Java and Sumatra (public information). Not verified in this build.
source: public information (not verified in this build)

name: Lombok Strait (Bali-Lombok)
note: Deep-water route between the Java Sea and the Indian Ocean (public information). Not verified in this build.
source: public information (not verified in this build)

name: Makassar Strait (Borneo-Sulawesi)
note: Strait between Borneo and Sulawesi (public information). Not verified in this build.
source: public information (not verified in this build)
